_comment: Optional config for scripts/upgrade/verifyBatchCalldata.ts. All fields optional — script falls back to --network / upgrade.json / deployed-facets-{network}.json / deployed-peripherals-{network}.json.
_only_comment: If set (non-empty array), only these labels are verified. Omit to verify all. Env ONLY=... overrides.
_skip_comment: Labels to skip. Applied after 'only'. Env SKIP=... overrides.
_artifacts_comment: When true (default), each facet's selectors in deployed-facets-{network}.json are cross-checked against the locally compiled facet ABI. Disable if artifacts aren't compiled locally. Env VERIFY_ARTIFACTS=false overrides.
_paths_comment: Per-file overrides. Any omitted key falls back to {outputDir}/{name}-{networkName}.json. Timelock dirs should contain the chunked files matching timelock-{schedule|execute}-safe-batch-{network}-N.json.
